resources.string: Describe the room: its size, the rows and columns of seats, and what the walls and floor are made of. You can also load a sample room to explore.
Find out how clearly people can hear at each seat. You clap at the front while the phone listens at a few seats, then it checks the background noise.
After measuring, you\'ll see which seats can follow the speaker, and whether echo, noise or distance is the problem.
Try cheap changes before spending money: curtains, switching off fans, moving the speaker or using a microphone. ClearRoom predicts how much each one helps.
Leave the phone in the room to see how background noise changes through the day. Only sound levels are kept, never audio.
ClearRoom needs the microphone to measure sound levels. It never records or stores speech.
Without the microphone, ClearRoom can\'t measure the room. It only measures sound levels, never speech.
Microphone access is turned off for ClearRoom. Turn it on in Settings, under Permissions.
Microphone ready. Clap tests and noise checks arrive in the next build.
